result.title: Training Vision Transformers to Focus: Emergence of Spatial Attention Head Specialization
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://yuji-nozawa.github.io/ReFoCo/
result.summary: Self-supervised learning in Vision Transformer models, such as DINO, enables robust visual perception without requiring labeled data by leveraging large-scale image datasets. However, these models lack a focusing mechanism during training, resulting in perceptual representations that are often ambiguous or overly similar. In this work, we introduce two visual focusing loss functions designed to establish correspondence between the model's attention and specific regions within images. Specifically, we leverage the multi-head attention mechanism within the model to selectively steer the model's focus, leading to the emergence of spatial attention head specialization, characterized by diverse and spatially focused perceptual capabilities without requiring annotations. Through both qualitative and quantitative evaluations, we demonstrate that our method substantially increases the spatial selectivity and diversity of attention heads, improving both interpretability and performance on dense prediction tasks such as zero-shot image segmentation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 DINO 类自监督 ViT 中引入两种视觉聚焦损失，将模型注意力对齐到图像特定区域，促使注意力头形成更强且更多样的空间选择性，并评估零样本分割等密集预测任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以损失塑造注意力头的空间分工，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与内部视觉细节保留提供辅助训练线索，但未涉及推理或 latent 状态，迁移可行性有待核查。
